notes.title: New Autumn Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It’s been a long time without updates, and many thought there would be no more. Perhaps I expressed myself incorrectly earlier: I meant that there will be [b]no more big updates[/b], but [b]small and medium ones[/b] will continue to be released.

[h2]Today I'm excited to show you a new update, which also comes with a killer 70% discount starting [b]September 22nd at 10 GMT-7![/b] So, let's get started: [/h2]

[h2]New Features and Changes[/h2][p]
Added a new game mode [b]Custom Mode[/b]. In it, you can set:
 • Day and night duration
 • Disable hunger and energy drain
 • Disable weather
 • Enable any available season
 • Cheats are enabled by default in this mode
 • Game difficulty selection is available
•Added a new [b]Research Machine[/b]. Now you can obtain [b]blueprints for the parts you •need[/b].
•Added a [b]basket[/b] for buying all parts from day and night sellers at once.
•Added [b]all crafting parts[/b]  now you can produce absolutely everything available in the game.
•Added a [b]“Reroll Cards”[/b]button.
 • You can now reroll bonus cards, with the number of rerolls depending on their rarity.
•Added [b]night brightness settings[/b].
•Added new [b]tutorial markers[/b].
•Added a new [b]Halloween season[/b]:
 • The event launches every October (or can be enabled separately in Custom Mode).
 • Weather changes to overcast, with fog instead of rain.
 • NPCs get a Halloween-themed appearance.
 • [b]Pumpkins[/b] will appear on the streets: if you set them on fire, you will gain [b]20% of maximum experience[/b].
•Added an [b]icon in the warehouse[/b] over parts if you hired a garbage man.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/c97fafa68faaa5e99e3848f6a57707c4ba553896.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/84ff2c65b59cfeeaeeff9464f8d6e6aa7daac324.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/7a923a9448a1056d0f07072afb09894cd93bf089.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/50eb0b9dd2bf822c117ac51e8204975169be2c85.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/40d858f9ef8e6a9b741c205b85a017caa8aef07d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/87d73e4b5d4d7e84bdc56370b1c72b056fc142bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/52d6890825e0b9c24c6ea4dcfe3b07a05fc63cdf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/986623cd19191cb71dc81022d375b25c86cb2153.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/4e979ccaf79d29da83f3c087131a06ce768b73ce.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Changes and Reworks[/h2][p]
•Increased the price of blueprints.
•Decreased the chance of blueprints appearing in shops.
•Reworked [b]Historical Mode[/b]: cheats are no longer available, and difficulty cannot be changed.
•The [b]old shooting range mechanic[/b] has returned: residents can now test weapons they purchased. The old system also remains if you place weapons and ammo, regular residents will come and shoot.
•Expanded the [b]winter location[/b].
•During rain, the world is now [b]much brighter.[/b]
•Shadows have become a bit darker to balance brightness.
•Changed the bonus card cancel mechanic: if you don’t want to pick a card, you will now receive [b]25% of maximum experience[/b].
•Fixed and improved winter materials in some locations.
•The character now [b]moves slower while crouching[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/78c681228d9db74eb153f6c77057e39e880c6567.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/f3e6e3dcd67e0470fcc5c16f9dca6a3f4eb48b3c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/720f09bd05f9c5b01070436eeb711692a4b6c3f0.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p]
•Fixed some [b]minor issues[/b].
•Fixed the [b]winter menu[/b].
•Fixed [b]snow footstep sounds[/b] for both player and residents.
•Fixed a bug where parts from gifts did not move to the warehouse.
•Fixed an issue with the name of [b]Mr. Daryl[/b].

[b]That’s all for now![/b]
A huge thank you to everyone who is testing this is very important to me 💙 In this update, I tried to implement many of your suggestions.

Don’t forget about the upcoming [b]discount[/b]!
There will also be a discount on all [b]my games in one bundle[/b]. I look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Devblog #16
notes.content:
[h1]Small Dev Blog[/h1]

Hello everyone! Today I want to share with you the latest changes and new features. All of this is already available in the [i]test branch[/i], but I don’t recommend running it on your saves yet — there’s still a lot of work in progress, and something might go wrong and break your main game.

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a [b]Researcher machine[/b]: it studies parts and gives out a blueprint of that part. After studying it, you’ll be able to craft it, but you’ll lose the original part.
[*]Added a [b]card re-roll mechanic[/b]: if the cards don’t suit you, you can re-roll them until your attempts run out.
[*]Introduced a [b]bonus re-roll card[/b]: its rarity determines how many extra re-rolls you get.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/52d6890825e0b9c24c6ea4dcfe3b07a05fc63cdf.png[/img]

[h2]Blueprint Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Price increased (from 250 to 450).
[*]Chance of appearance reduced to 40% — they will be sold less frequently.
[*]Added new blueprints: now you can study all existing parts in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Balance & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added [b]night brightness adjustment[/b] — now everyone can tweak it to their liking.
[*]Increased global brightness (including during rain).
[*]Slightly strengthened shadows to balance the brightness increase.
[*]Canceling cards now gives not a fixed 100 XP, but [b]25% of the maximum XP[/b] required to reach the next level.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/4e979ccaf79d29da83f3c087131a06ce768b73ce.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Mr. Daryl’s name in dialogues was displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Events[/h2]
[list]
[*]Preparation of locations for the [b]Winter Event[/b] is already in full swing.
[*]Fixing old terrain bugs.
[*]Started preparing for [b]Halloween[/b] this year. From now on, Halloween will launch every October.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/720f09bd05f9c5b01070436eeb711692a4b6c3f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/78c681228d9db74eb153f6c77057e39e880c6567.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
Thanks to everyone who leaves reviews — both positive and negative. I see all your comments and try to fix and implement them into the game. I don’t ignore feedback, I just sort it by importance.

I also wanted to make the dialogue text smaller for easier reading, but I need more time to do this carefully — I’m afraid to break something before the update, and this is very important.

[h2]When to Expect[/h2]
All changes are already uploaded to the [b]test branch[/b], and you can try them out.
Join our Discord channel if you want to know how to access the test branch.
Welcome to all new players! :)
I’m waiting for your feedback!

It's time for a small but no less interesting update

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a statistics window before sleep, now you will understand where you earn and where you spend (very useful for strategy planning)
[*] Added the ability to upgrade the warehouse, this opens up the ability to highlight parts for quests and orders. Assembling weapons becomes easier
[*] Added advertisement banners for service, shooting range, and toilets, after building them more residents will visit
[*] Now, ammo in the shooting range will transfer to the new level after upgrading
[*] Added text on the ammo showing how many shooting range attempts they give
[*] Added a chance to find blueprints on the map from Karl, now he can bring blueprints from his trips

[*] Added a decor building that increases received tips
[*] Added an icon above the bio toilet showing that it's dirty (now easier to know when to clean it)
[*] Added salary display for tomorrow, now you will know how much will be deducted for wages
[*] Added reputation loss if you close the door in the service area while a customer is entering
[*] Added tool breakage for cleaning or repairing quest items
[*] Added reputation loss if you don’t pay a worker (if you have no money, set it as a day off)
[*] Added messages when reputation is lost
[*] Added the ability to add or remove items in the queue in the auto craft tab
[*] Added reputation loss if you close the store while customers are entering
[*] Added description for detail price arrows
[*] Added description for advertisement banners
[*] Added item receiving animations for quest characters
[*] Added a "How to play" button in the menu, with a brief explanation of what to do in the game
[*] Added localization
[/list]

PimpGameStudio[/i]

notes.title: Rise Of Gun v6: Story Mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4Gn2mKiLTso;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

The time has come for the [b]big, big, big updateeeeee[/b] — this is the very massive update!
This will be the last update, next will be new games and some minor fixes for Rise Of Gun

[h2][b]Rise Of Gun v6: Story Mode[/b][/h2]  
You've been waiting for this for a long time, and here it is!  
In this big update, I’ve also included a bunch of smaller ones, so it took a bit more time to complete.  
I hope you didn’t get too bored while waiting and that this pleasantly surprises you. As mentioned earlier — [b]the price of the game will increase[/b].
But, I decided to do it in the [b]summer[/b], and now it would be better to make a [b]35% discount[/b], so hurry up and it will be today

I’ve worked really hard to make it fun and exciting.  
According to my calculations, [b]gameplay time will increase by more than 10 hours![/b]  
You’ll find [b]story mode[/b], [b]quests[/b], [b]dialogues[/b], [b]new mechanics[/b], [b]sound and visual improvements[/b].

I’ll be very grateful for reviews on Steam — they really motivate me. My goal is 1000 reviews. Thank you for your support throughout development. Let’s move on to the update:

[h2]Story Mode[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added a large number of story quests that will not only help you understand the background, but also reveal what’s happening in the town. Be in the thick of the action — your actions will influence the transformation of the survivor settlement. Help the residents not just with weapons but also with their living conditions — after all, they’ve all grown to love you.  
[*] New characters (Secretary Elli, Warehouse Chief Tom, Farmer Hank, Defense Leader Mr. Pawns, Homeless Chester, City Mayor Governor, and many others)  
[*] Added dialogue system — now you can talk to residents and learn lots of interesting things about what happened before the apocalypse and how it began. Short stories from the lives of the townsfolk will give you vivid impressions and reveal the picture of this beautiful apocalyptic world.  
[*] Added an interactive map of the area — it will help you learn much more about what lies beyond the city limits, which you can't reach yourself. Adventurer Carl will help you with this — you can send him on expeditions to various locations. When he returns, you’ll receive a reward and a piece of the story from what Carl saw there. Discover more about this world.  
[/list]

[h2]New Workers[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added a new worker — Ammo Maker. Now you can automatically produce ammo. The worker can place the ammo either on the shelf or on the ammo crafting table. Also, if the workday ends during crafting, he’ll continue the next day.  
[*] Added a Worker for crafting parts. Now in the parts crafting menu, you can choose automatic production. After crafting, the parts will immediately be transferred to the warehouse. If the shift ends, the crafting machine will continue working.  
[*] Added a new worker for parts recycling. He gives you the ability to recycle parts directly from the warehouse — this saves a lot of time.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/a1707da1440a5d2a2c36ec91e79afd67f4f5794d.png[/img]

[h2]New Vendors[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added a vendor of Experience Books. He appears only during rain in a random location.  
[*] Added a new vendor, Mr. Daryl. He will buy your weapons. Works only at night. Pays in scrap and money.  
[*] Added a new vendor, Tom. He sells tools. Works 24/7 with no breaks.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/6753288f5e4af39fddfba415738241102b362027.png[/img]

[h2]Bicycle[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added a new type of transport — bicycle. You can find it on the map and repair it. After fixing it, you’ll be able to move faster around the map and also transport boxes of food, ammo, weapons, water bottles. It greatly simplifies completing quests and managing the store.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/cbd836bfcc025a6efe5b386effe6e2055fb30a94.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Mechanics[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added 18 new parts.  
[*] Added a new shift system for workers — now you can choose the days of the week your worker will work.  
[*] Added window repairs in the house — now you can build windows in your home.  
[*] Added window repairs in the shop — now you can build windows in your store.  
[*] Added 1 spin by default at the start of the game.  
[*] Added earning money, experience, and scrap for playing the piano. There’s a small chance of getting a random reward.  
[*] Added more parts in the world.  
[*] Added saving of experience on the computer.  
[*] Added more blueprints in the world.  
[*] Added experience gain from finding parts — and now they teleport directly to the warehouse.  
[*] Added reputation leveling when selling parts and buying blueprints from Ray and Albert.  
[*] Added new mechanic — tool breakage. Now tools wear out from frequent use.  
[*] Added new tutorial pages in the tutorial tab.  
[*] Added 10 new achievements.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/e04092056abe8ce6e491a417ab96c9b7158835d0.png[/img]

I recommend starting a new game for those who will be testing. If you want to participate in testing, join our Discord channel—there you will find all the detailed information.

[h1]New Workers[/h1]

[h2]Parts Creator[/h2]
A new worker who creates parts. To hire them, you need to build a crafting machine. After that, a new "Automation" tab will appear in the crafting menu, where you can select multiple parts for production. All crafted parts are immediately sent to storage. Otherwise, this worker functions like the others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/444d2d4406f0d9df61c55c75110f934236508a91.png[/img]

A new worker who creates ammunition. To hire them, you need to build an ammo-making machine. After that, you can hire the worker. By approaching and interacting with them, the automation menu will open, where you can select various types of ammo to craft. The automation menu offers two production methods:
1. Creating ammo and placing it on the ammo shelf.
2. Creating ammo and placing it on the shelf of the ammo-making machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/275fb56630103991e20dc0865551f2a4634ac3bb.png[/img]

- New spare parts.
- Voice acting and facial animation for city residents (adds atmosphere).
- Raft physics in the pool.

notes.title: Rise of gun V4.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The time has come for a big update. A lot of time has passed, and thank you to everyone who waited. Especially to everyone who helped me test the test branch in Discord, I am very grateful to you; you sped up this update. This is the penultimate big update, so there are a lot of changes. I will be glad to hear your feedback.

[b]So, to the update:[/b]

[b]New Currency Scrap Metal[/b]

A new currency, scrap metal, has been added. With it, you can upgrade all necessary objects, as well as create bullets and parts. Scrap metal can be found on the street and also obtained by cleaning up large debris. If you build a trash can, you can get scrap metal from small debris. A recycler has also been added, which allows you to recycle parts into scrap metal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/0b0883f77891bf676f71c0747d759ffe5663305f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/1bc205ab0581c42c287b651709675ac79a84a02c.png[/img]

[b]Workers[/b]

Three types of workers have been added to the game:
- Cashier — will help you sell weapons.
- Cleaner — will help you clean up small debris in the shop.
- Guard — will prevent thieves from stealing weapons.

Lockers for workers have also been added. After building them, you will be able to hire workers. If you click on the locker, a workers menu will open.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/a19afe6a603f729c17ba17023ed4aae8d5ab607a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/d2a1054872704326d57745cc7e458d600a9fcf8a.png[/img]

[b]Creating Parts[/b]

A workbench for creating parts has been added to the game. With it, you can create your own parts using scrap metal. For it to work, you need to build a solar panel. During rain, part creation will be impossible, but if you build a canopy, you can create parts even in the rain. You can also find hidden blueprints on the map, or buy them from the night vendor. Blueprints unlock access to new parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/0621888c7a5ea8aa59315544c35dfe64d23103d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/b8f097acb013911730799c2caabd1f242bb7d74e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/082a64dee0e4b14ef467580e67580e58a0527e21.png[/img]

[b]New Parts[/b]

31 new parts have been added to the game:
- Basic parts — 5 new parts
- Stock — 3 new parts
- Magazine — 3 new parts
- Grip — 3 new parts
- Barrel — 4 new parts
- Sight — 2 new parts
- Muzzle attachments — 4 new parts
- Attachments — 8 new parts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/83d4a0548af55cd73719890563e18525ee1050c3.png[/img]

[b]City Expansion[/b]

New locations have appeared in the game, such as a casino and main gates. Animations have also been added for the soldiers guarding the walls, and a ladder climbing system. There are now more residents in the city, who can sit on benches or chat with each other. A ladder can be built in the backyard to climb onto the shop roof. Residents have new hairstyles, beards, and headwear. The design of the parts vendor's shop has been changed. More secret places have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/47c5af42a1157e6156bb8140c57a4d64894ee8d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/e2573ca2f53505e0827faa3577650658806cea26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/bdbdcac1dcb7d4b5a08e356c1ef22a544722a1f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/fdc219a84e6edad7b0505a13a3e022119ee58f7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/f05b8316704f88f76d816941d39e5bf0a339e461.png[/img]

[b]New Decor[/b]

Several new decor elements have been added to the shop, such as clocks, flower pots, etc. The cash register model has been changed. The radio model has also been changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/a35a88aaeaf6e78de9ad8fa77b927982030f4148.png[/img]

[b]New Buildings[/b]

New buildings have also been added to help you earn money or make the game easier:
- Food storage — if you build food storage, food boxes you buy will be teleported to the storage.
- Water storage — if you build water storage, water you buy or collect will be teleported to the storage.
- Water collector — during rain, it will collect water, which you can then gather.
- Toilet — after building a toilet, residents will pay to use it, and it will need to be cleaned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/254e8cc0a2cb6c4c1012535085de9837f754a223.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/39b071a4c08b1c9c911809864c35d1a42bf4d37c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/483a93bbc56bb43a4e3015f334f03102c12a142f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/c6a03b437d12748eb2eeabf53acf1265061b208c.png[/img]

[b]New Shooting Range System[/b]

The shooting range has been reworked. Now, after building it, you need to leave weapons and ammunition there. Depending on the weapon's price, residents will pay more for using the range, and the ammunition will determine the number of shots they can take. Ammunition will run out, and weapons can be retrieved at any time. Gates for the range have also been added. After opening them and having weapons and ammunition, residents can shoot. A lamp has been added to the range, which automatically activates at night.

Added:
- Zoom — now on the "C" key, you can zoom the camera.
- New loading screens.
- Weapon shelf markup — the higher the shelf level, the higher the markup.
- Tutorial activation choice at the beginning of the game.
- Cheat activation choice at the beginning of the game.

- Animation at the beginning of the game showing you getting out of bed.

notes.title: End of Early Access
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b]! Well, the moment has come, when "Rise of Gun" comes out of early access. I apologize in advance for taking so long to update. I've added a lot of new stuff and fixed old bugs thanks to you and your feedback. [b]WARNING: THE UPDATE IS VERY DIFFERENT FROM THE PREVIOUS VERSION, SO IT MAY BE UNCOMFORTABLE TO PLAY ON OLD SAVES. GLAD TO START A NEW GAME.[/b]

[b]And so, to the main updates:[/b]

[b]Order Board.[/b] The Order Board will give you the opportunity to take orders, fulfilling them you can earn even more money.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/eacc498659b4ed715166af0b14ebb32f74084f5d.png[/img]

[b]Creating ammo.[/b] Ammo now needs to be created and sold like a weapon. Ammo can also be stolen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/afc4c7aa60a2fc5c0e55ebcd073c31296f15dffd.png[/img]

[b]Carmelita.[/b] While it was winter, thanks to you, Carmelita was able to open a restaurant, now she sells not only hot dogs, but also food for sale, as well as water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/1a021f592066f4062c5efd2f1bd2e8d5669ff214.png[/img]

[b]Shooting range[/b] Now you can build a shooting range where your customers can test your weapons and they will pay you for it too. The shooting range can be improved by increasing your loot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/93ece0b17015e37ba196cc613715b8b68368a101.png[/img]

[b]Weapon Shelf Improvements.[/b]The weapon shelf will now initially have fewer slots, you can upgrade them, thereby increasing the number of weapons sold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/3e5b8b7f01d7fb8892c8d1e56651ac1676191408.png[/img]

[b]Machine Upgrades.[/b] Machines can now be upgraded, each level of the machine will add a bonus to your weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/66ad5843f900063ea1d82301a0578622773ea15d.png[/img]

[b]Improving the bed.[/b] After improving the bed, sleeping will be even more pleasant.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/d858129f7ff71f22af9fe569c5d4693d8d4262d8.jpg[/img]

[b]Quick access board.[/b] If you build a quick access board, you will be able to move items to it from the inventory, this will add more convenience to weapon crafting, useful for orders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/d25b054c670c6883c8ad95b60ce9828dc7a366d1.png[/img]

[b]Vending machine.[/b] The vending machine allows you to sell and eat food in your shop. After building it, you need to buy food from Carmelita, and then take it to the machine. You can also buy water for a cooler from Carmelita.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/4bd76ceeb49e8c6ede4538879128d236232c2622.png[/img]

[b]Alarm.[/b] Once the alarm is built, no thief will get in, it starts screaming when a buyer steals a weapon. Even if you are in the workshop, you will still hear that you are being robbed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/ae82a34f517e962a98f09d923a7dbc5e57529ab3.png[/img]

[b]New Vendor[/b] The new vendor is only open at night and has a little more stock. This will give you the opportunity to make your weapons at night so that you
sell them or fulfill orders during the day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/153c689dd0d0f6dbc6a79c569cefd5d127366bea.jpg[/img]

[b]Compass.[/b] The game has added a compass to help you navigate. It shows all the necessary places.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/5b6318ba8543783840fe1e125286a6ad5d4ac127.png[/img]

[b]Updated parts icons.[/b] Base parts and muzzles now show the number of slots that parts can be attached to. This will help in selecting the appropriate parts.

[b]New parts [/b]Also, new spare parts have been added to the game, they will help you create the unique weapon of your dreams.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/1a50a405d7868c4e90653f95bae3d7a162c508c4.jpg[/img]

[b]New buyer AI system.[/b] Buyer behavior algorithm has been changed. Now buyers will approach first of all those regiments where there are weapons or cartridges, and only then to the rest of the objects.

[b]Rain.[/b] When it rains, there will be fewer people on the streets, so the number of customers coming to you will also decrease. Rain happens on random days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/4d8192e733fa11fdc059ba0962ee75af62bc90cd.png[/img]

[b]New tutorial system.[/b] A new tutorial system has appeared. After building some objects, a video tutorial will pop up to help you understand how it works. It cannot be turned off!!

[b]More missions.[/b] Old missions have been changed and new ones have been added and their order has also been changed. There are now 25 missions in the game, this will help you track your progress in the game.

[b]Doorbell.[/b] If you want to hear when someone walks in, build a doorbell. It will help you hear from the workshop that the buyer has arrived.
[b]
Other changes:[/b]

-Added days of the week.
- Now you can sleep after 8 pm, not only when you are tired.
- System of improvements.
-The trash can reduces the amount of trash from customers.
-Added sorting in the warehouse by prices.

notes.title: Rise of Gun: Early Access
notes.content:
[b]Rise of Gun: Early Access - What's New?[/b]

Hi all! Thank you for waiting, trying the demo and supporting us. Your feedback is incredibly important, and thanks to you we were able to release the game into Early Access.

[b]1. Interface[/b]
The new interface has been redesigned and fixed. It has become more convenient and intuitive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/071bd37260e4446725fd1d00f0df5808d611ba3a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/289e872503bc54e42373adfcb86bfda0d30a7f28.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Settings[/b]
Added multiple settings that were missing in the demo version: keyboard, mouse and graphics settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/289e872503bc54e42373adfcb86bfda0d30a7f28.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Localization[/b]
Localization is very important to us. Although it is not completely ready yet, the main part is already there. I apologize for temporary errors in translation.

[b]4. Saves[/b]
The game now has a save system, which we continue to work on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/c3126e98caac03df61030018dd386f8eb789c4a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/98d484dda9f765dee7eb0d789c8cdc607b3c7a3b.jpg[/img]

[b]5. Hunger and Energy[/b]
Added two new parameters: Hunger and Energy. Energy is spent throughout the day and can be restored by sleeping. Hunger is also wasted and affects energy expenditure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/6fce4440b4d659b48ff073637e6f8aa5922f0cac.jpg[/img]

[b]6. Reputation and Purity[/b]
The game now has a reputation and store cleanliness system that affects various aspects of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/39acbe929ae9d3ab43638e76775e5885ffb962d1.jpg[/img]

[b]7. Sorting in warehouse[/b]
Many people have asked for sorting, and now it is already in early access. Sorting in the warehouse is divided into several types of parts, and the quantity of specific spare parts is also indicated. This will help you a lot in the future when there are too many parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/b1db88b1a1c1cdd5302464a8a4c0a8f0d9d11445.jpg[/img]

[b]8. Ghosts of details[/b]
Ghosts of parts have appeared to help you understand where the part will be placed. You can also visually see how it will look on your weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/be37ac6bf79bbd99ca65ad063a43b669420a8cb0.jpg[/img]

[b]9. Missions[/b]
There was only one mission available in the demo. There are currently 14 of them in Early Access. These are progression missions; you will not receive a reward for them, but you will have a great goal to reach the end and complete all the missions. In the future, missions from residents will also be added, for which you will receive a reward.

[b]10. Thieves[/b]
Thieves are very dangerous and will keep you on your toes. But don't be afraid, you can always catch him to get your weapon back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/1c4e5775d45fd080dd65b975b6386ebe1f8752c7.jpg[/img]

[b]11. Closing the store[/b]
What many have asked for: closing and reopening the store. Now you can just close the shop and make a bunch of weapons. In addition, residents stop walking after 20:00.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/29276625f6f45bc58844a1dbbf5e298326140875.jpg[/img]

[b]12. New shelf system[/b]
Weapon shelves have been changed and slots have been added. Now you can choose where to place your masterpiece crafted weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/5a15c1af34c24855d469ef734fed0d7374f1f5f1.jpg[/img]

[b]13. Augmented map[/b]
The map has been improved, secret places have also been added, as well as optimization.

[b]14. Tutorial[/b]
A new tutorial system was created. At the beginning of the game it asks if you want to complete it. If yes, red circles will appear in front of you; by entering them, an explanation of the mechanics will open to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/10709a1e2fa072c07080c45e39355742d80d9d62.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/670d1a0b34e2cfadf6a14fd34cae6b5ab92f391a.jpg[/img]

[b]15. Optimization[/b]
A lot of work has been done on optimization. Lighting has been optimized, volumetric clouds have been replaced with 2D, the number of inhabitants in the city has been reduced, and the code has been optimized. Thanks to all this, "Rise of Gun" can be played by everyone. Many bugs have been fixed.

[b]16. New seller[/b]
A new vendor has also been added to help you avoid starvation. Carmelita stands on the street and sells hot dogs. At night it closes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/6fce4440b4d659b48ff073637e6f8aa5922f0cac.jpg[/img]


We continue to work to improve the game and welcome your feedback and suggestions. Thanks for your support!
